title: Florida House, District 98
what_it_does: Represents District 98 (Part of Broward) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Mitch Rosenwald (Democratic) is listed as unopposed by the Florida Division of Elections and is elected without appearing on the November ballot. Source: https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Mitch Rosenwald
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Professor of social work at Barry University; licensed clinical social worker
candidates.background: Mitch Rosenwald is a professor of social work and director of doctoral studies at Barry University's School of Social Work and a licensed clinical social worker. He served on the Oakland Park city commission and as mayor of Oakland Park (2023-2024) before winning House District 98 in 2024. In the House he has served on the Health & Human Services Committee. He won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Keith Abel with 56.6% of the vote.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: He voted against CS/CS/HJR 203 (2026), a proposed constitutional amendment to exempt homesteads from all non-school property taxes; it passed the House 80-30 on Feb. 19, 2026, then died in the Senate. He did not vote on HJR 1-F in the June 2026 special session.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/CS/HJR 203 (2026) passage, Feb. 19, 2026 (Rosenwald-98: Nay)

guns.summary: He voted against HB 133 (2026), which would lower the minimum age to buy long guns from 21 to 18; it passed the House 74-37 on Jan. 15, 2026. He did not vote on the 2025 version (HB 759).

sources.title: Florida House roll call, HB 133 (2026) passage, Jan. 15, 2026 (Rosenwald-98: Nay)

elections.summary: He voted against CS/HB 1205 (2025), which added new rules and penalties for the citizen-initiative petition process; it passed the House 81-30 on May 1, 2025.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, CS/HB 1205 (2025) final passage, May 1, 2025 (Rosenwald-98: Nay)

immigration.summary: He was one of the few Democrats who voted for HB 197 (2026), which would require all private employers to use E-Verify to check new hires' work eligibility; it passed the House 80-30 on Jan. 15, 2026. He did not vote on SB 2-C, the February 2025 special-session immigration law.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, HB 197 (2026) passage, Jan. 15, 2026 (Rosenwald-98: Yea)

housing.summary: His campaign site says he is working to expand affordable housing and lower property-insurance costs. He has not named specific programs.
housing.quote: fighting every day to lower property insurance costs, expand affordable housing

record.item: Voted against SB 1134 (2026), barring local governments from funding or promoting diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives; it passed the House 77-37 on Mar. 10, 2026.

sources.title: Florida House roll call, SB 1134 (2026) passage, Mar. 10, 2026 (Rosenwald-98: Nay)
